title: Categorical assembly of the normalized completed limit data
statement: For arbitrary abelian categories with the fixed derived localizations, endpoint isomorphisms for a total derived limit, completeness of both completed endpoints, bijectivity of coefficient restriction on their hom-set, and compatible finite reduction equations imply diagonalCompleteDataAssertion. This is a categorical assembly lemma; it proves existence and uniqueness by conjugating the underlying map and using fullness and faithfulness. The same module proves conversion of homogeneous heterogeneous finite equations to finite normalization, and combines normalized strict-system witnesses with completed compatibility using the caller's exact normalization functions. DiagonalStrictDataSpec is the fully defined strict part of the assertion, with the same witnesses and equations, excluding completed compatibility.

source.place: paragraph (3), unique completed arrow and finite compatibility

proof.text: Conjugate the underlying arrow by the source and inverse target comparisons, lift it through the hom-set bijection, and cancel the invertible target comparison for uniqueness. Retain the endpoint normalization and completeness hypotheses. For each finite level, retain the supplied comparison isomorphisms and their three equations. All of these operations are proved generically before specializing the categories.

For the finite normalization, retain each pair of endpoint isomorphisms and use eq_of_heq. Define DiagonalStrictDataSpec as the explicit strict-system witnesses, hom equation and finite normalization. The first strict assembly lemma translates a supplied finite predicate on those witnesses. The full assembly lemma retains the same witnesses and adds their completed compatibility. All witness elimination is proved generically in the abelian categories. The named strict-data mapping theorem performs the same witness-preserving finite-predicate implication on already assembled strict data.

theorem diagonalCompleteData_of_bijective
    {A : Type a} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    {B : Type b} [Category.{u} B] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A)] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B)]
    [HasLimitsOfShape ℕᵒᵖ B]
    (ℓ : ℕ) (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (P Q : A) (S H : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B) (K J : DerivedCategory (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B))
    (f : K ⟶ J)
    (a : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj S)
    (b : J ≅ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj H)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (sourceNorm : (F.obj P ≅ limit S) → Prop)
    (targetNorm : (F.obj Q ≅ limit H) → Prop)
    (L : DiagonalRlim B) (M : DiagonalCompletedReductionData ℓ A)
    (s : F.obj P ≅ limit S) (t : F.obj Q ≅ limit H)
    (hs : sourceNorm s) (ht : targetNorm t)
    (hsource : IsIso (diagonalSingleLimitComparison F L P S K s a))
    (htarget : IsIso (diagonalShiftedSingleLimitComparison F L Q H J t b))
    (hP : ∀ V : DerivedCategory A, IsIso (ℓ • 𝟙 V) →
      Subsingleton (V ⟶ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P))
    (hQ : ∀ V : DerivedCategory A, IsIso (ℓ • 𝟙 V) →
      Subsingleton (V ⟶ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj Q)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (hF : Function.Bijective (fun δ : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj Q)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧ ↦ F.mapDerivedCategory.map δ))
    (hfinite : ∀ δ : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj Q)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
      F.mapDerivedCategory.map δ ≫ diagonalShiftedSingleLimitComparison F L Q H J t b =
        diagonalSingleLimitComparison F L P S K s a ≫ L.R.map f → ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∃ (e : F.mapDerivedCategory.obj
            ((((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ A).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory).obj
              (M.derived.T.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P))) ≅
            (((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ B).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory).obj K)
        (g : F.mapDerivedCategory.obj
            ((((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ A).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory).obj
              (M.derived.T.obj (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj Q)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))) ≅
            (((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ B).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory).obj J),
        F.mapDerivedCategory.map ((M.unit n).app _) ≫ e.hom =
          diagonalSingleLimitComparison F L P S K s a ≫ (L.projection n).app K ∧
        F.mapDerivedCategory.map ((M.unit n).app _) ≫ g.hom =
          diagonalShiftedSingleLimitComparison F L Q H J t b ≫ (L.projection n).app J ∧
        F.mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ A).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory).map (M.derived.T.map δ)) =
          e.hom ≫ (((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ B).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory).map f ≫ g.inv) :
    diagonalCompleteDataAssertion ℓ F P Q S H K J f a b sourceNorm targetNorm
